title: Power
desc: Jeetu, a young man, wants to join the force but is discouraged by his brother-in-law, a police officer. A dejected Jeetu steals his uniform and goes around pretending to be an officer of the law.

title: Anbarivu
desc: Twins, Anbu and Arivu, are separated at birth. Later, when their paths cross, the siblings are forced to switch families, as they strive to reunite their loved ones.

title: Viruman
desc: Viruman is a young man who watches his mother immolate herself. As a result, he distances himself from his father and vows to avenge her death.

title: Pechi
desc: Accompanied by a guide, five friends go on a trekking trip to a haunted forest and despite being warned, they enter a restricted area that harbours an evil spirit.

title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
desc: A smuggling kingpin faces off against a vengeful rival while manipulating politics, making big deals and navigating tense confrontations.

title: Asura Vettai
desc: After losing his family, Sanjeev embarks on a journey of revenge, uncovering a deadly secret with Shruti's aid and confronting Raghupathi, who holds the key to the formula's destructive power.

title: Supreme
desc: A charitable trust faces threats from a powerful mafia leader who has set his eyes on its land. He plans to kill the legal heir to grab the wealth, but a brave taxi driver becomes an impediment.

title: Gentleman Sathya
desc: Sathyam and Chaitra meet unexpectedly in their pursuit of making quick money. Soon after they fall in love, Sathyam encounters Padmanabham, a criminal on the run from the Indian police.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Most Eligible Bachelor
desc: Harsha, a successful expat, is willing to marry any woman his parents choose for him. However, he eventually falls for Vibha, an outspoken lady, who challenges his views on marriage.

title: Marina
desc: Ambikathy, an orphan, leaves his cruel uncle and ends up at Marina Beach, where he sells food to save money for night school, determined to pursue his dream of getting an education.

title: Paranthu Po
desc: A struggling father and his stubborn son take on a road trip to escape the pressures of their daily lives and along the way discover the valuable things missing from their lives.

title: Annabelle Sethupathi
desc: Rudra, a petty burglar, stumbles upon an uninhabited castle. However, when she learns of the tragedy marring its history, she vows to free the residents trapped against their will.

title: Eeram
desc: Vasu vows to uncover Ramya's killer after he stumbles upon her corpse in an apartment. However, as more murders occur, he learns that Ramya's vengeful spirit is behind the killings.

title: Ruler
desc: A businesswoman adopts a stranger who saves her life and raises him as her son. However, the young man has a dark past that catches up with him despite his mother's attempts to shield him from it.

title: Bhoomi
desc: Bhoominathan, a NASA scientist, helps his village people against the evil corporations.
